answer.worked:
Equal amounts require equal ratio parts, so the missing ratio value is $8$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Jenny : Ben}&=8:8\\\text{Jenny}&=\$33\div2=\$16.50\\\text{Ben}&=\$16.50\\\text{Jenny's fraction}&=\frac{8}{8+8}=\frac12\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Ratio: $8:4$; total: $\$24$; Jenny: $\$16$; Jenny gets $\$8$ more.
answer.worked:
Jenny has $\frac23$ of the total, so Ben has $\frac13$ and Jenny : Ben is $2:1$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Jenny : Ben}&=2:1=8:4\\\text{1 part}&=\$8\div4=\$2\\\text{Total}&=(8+4)\times\$2=\$24\\\text{Jenny}&=8\times\$2=\$16\\\text{Difference}&=\$16-\$8=\$8\end{align*}$$Jenny gets $\$8$ more.
